recognize_zh: 中央一顆大型細胞，細胞核圓形偏小、染色質細緻，細胞質豐富、邊界不規則，內含吞噬的紅血球碎片、空泡與藍綠色顆粒狀含鐵血黃素（hemosiderin），這些吞噬物讓你認出它是組織球（巨噬細胞）。
features: Large cell with abundant, grey-purple cytoplasm and irregular, frayed cell borders
Single round nucleus, small relative to cell size, with fine to reticular chromatin
Cytoplasmic phagocytosed material including red cell fragments, vacuoles, and dark granules
Blue-green refractile pigment consistent with hemosiderin
Background of red cells without other nucleated cells in the field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage with a low N:C ratio, a single round nucleus with fine chromatin, and abundant cytoplasm with irregular borders. The cytoplasm contains phagocytosed red cell fragments, vacuoles, dark granular debris, and blue-green hemosiderin-like pigment. No intracellular microorganisms are identified at this resolution. Findings are consistent with a reactive histiocyte with phagocytic and iron-laden cytoplasmic contents.

ddx.vs: Hemophagocytosis requires intact engulfed erythrocytes, platelets, or nucleated cells, plus clinical HLH criteria, whereas this cell shows mainly fragmented debris and pigment.
Megakaryocytes have a large lobulated nucleus and pink granular cytoplasm without phagocytosed material.
Osteoclasts are multinucleated with many separate, similar nuclei rather than a single nucleus.
Organisms appear as uniform small yeasts with halos or amastigotes with a kinetoplast, which are not identified here.
